parameters.prompt:

xCaption: For Twitter/X. Punchy, under 280 chars, include relevant hashtags.

instaCaption: For Instagram. Engaging, use emojis, include sections like WHY THIS MATTERS and THE IMPACT, end with hashtags.

linkedinCaption: For LinkedIn. Professional thought-leadership style, use bullet points, ask engaging question at end.

Paper Title: ' + $json.body.title + '

Abstract: ' + $json.body.abstract }}
